apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/kc-town-hall-funding.ts:368-500 and apps/www/src/content/work/kc-town-hall.mdx:37-61 — governmental funding actions, Jamie's attributed transition account, unsupported transfer mechanics, later withdrawal, and private reasons remain distinct.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/public-registry.json:1415-1673 and scripts/generate-public-citations.mjs:10-31 — only the three selected social claims and renderable public sources reach the generated registry; the held identity claim and protected source are excluded.

scripts/tests/knowledge-development-evals.test.mjs:433-551 and scripts/tests/citations.test.mjs:93-160 — fresh Node 26 runs passed 24/24 lifecycle tests and 10/10 citation tests, including shared-account authorship and protected-source checks.
findings: Jamie's defensible direct actions are stated plainly, while institutional posts and coalition engagement are not converted into individual authorship.
The candidate consistently distinguishes observable engagement from endorsement, adoption, attendance, service impact, or policy causality.
Collaborator credit is preserved through shared-account language, explicit incidental-record exclusions, and WOW List's Jamie-and-Richard origin attribution.
The difficult KC Town Hall ending retains the unused-funds record and Jamie's separately attributed stewardship-through-transition account without importing private circumstances.
No rubric-level collective-credit or calibrated-causality defect was observed.
evals.recommended_next_move: Keep CLM-NYCAC-SHARED-IDENTITY-STEWARDSHIP held until RT-SOCIAL-NYCAC-ACCOUNT-ESTABLISHMENT-CORROBORATION produces permitted collaborator or dated account evidence; preserve post-level authorship boundaries in any later promotion.

apps/www/src/content/work/wowlist.mdx:9-30 — the selected social claim demonstrates onboarding, support, distribution, and civic-coordination use, while Jamie's role remains accurately framed as co-building and supporting the product.

docs/knowledge-bank/promotion-slate.md:64-77 and docs/knowledge-bank/projects/social-media-production.md:79-85 — the slate selects three bounded hiring-relevant social proofs, while the production record explicitly holds the account-establishment claim and retains three open research lanes.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/social-media-production.ts:1020-1097 — unresolved post-2020 coverage, Jamie's account-establishment role, and WOW List handle lineage remain visible as prioritized, testable research rather than weakened or prematurely promoted claims.

apps/www/src/data/work.ts:307-329,411-425,429-491 — hiring-facing metadata connects the evidence to civic delivery, coalition operations, product translation, community systems, and public-facing implementation while retaining Known/Open/Protected boundaries.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/kc-town-hall-funding.ts:368-500 and apps/www/src/content/work/kc-town-hall.mdx:18-61 — the project ending is candidly preserved as authorization followed by withdrawal and unused-fund reappropriation, alongside a bounded first-hand transition account framed as continuity stewardship.

scripts/tests/knowledge-development-evals.test.mjs:433-551,671-808 and scripts/tests/citations.test.mjs:93-160 — fresh Node 26 tests verify the social promotion/hold split, KC transition framing, public-registry resolution, and redaction boundaries.
findings: The selected social evidence adds hiring value as external engagement and operational product-use proof rather than vanity metrics.
Direct action, intended end, and usable result are legible across the selected case studies without inflating Jamie's causal share.
The strongest unresolved Jamie-specific social claim is named precisely, assigned high-priority corroboration work, and kept off public surfaces.
KC Town Hall demonstrates unusually candid long-horizon stewardship by retaining both the unsuccessful funding endpoint and the separately sourced transition context.

A minor editorial improvement would be to list CLM-NYCAC-SHARED-IDENTITY-STEWARDSHIP explicitly under the promotion slate's research-before-promotion section, although its held rationale is already auditable in the production record and task graph.
evals.recommended_next_move: Maintain the three selected social projections; add the held identity-stewardship claim to the next promotion-slate research section and promote it only after the high-priority corroboration task succeeds with public-use permission.
